item.title: Enhance UX for Beauty Industry Platform
item.description:
30-250 AUD | CoWorkz is a business operating system for the beauty industry: independent beauty professionals, salons, hybrid salons (employees plus rented chairs), shared-workspace / co-working operators, and the professionals who rent from them. It handles bookings, clients, content creation, payments and an AI assistant called Abby. The same codebase also runs The Beauty Basement, my own shared salon workspace in Perth, which is one customer-type example, not the identity of every member. The product has a very large feature surface that was built fast, largely with AI coding agents. It mostly works, but the UX is inconsistent, several workflows dead-end or over-promise, and the visual polish is not at the level a paying customer expects. I need a senior front-end/full-stack engineer with real product-design instinct to stabilise it, finish the core workflows properly, and get it to a state I can confidently sell and support.
The goal is not new features. It is: every core screen looks right, every core button does what it says, on desktop and phone.

item.title: Eco Laundry Site Revamp & Ads
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | Blue Sky Eco Laundry needs the contact-and-ordering section of our website completely refreshed. The goal is to give customers a smooth, attractive multi-step checkout that lets them schedule pickups, choose wash-and-fold options, review pricing, and pay securely—then funnels the order straight into our backend for effortless processing.
Here’s what has to happen: • Redesign the user interface of the contact and ordering module so it looks modern, loads fast on mobile, and guides users step-by-step. • Rebuild the order-processing logic so incoming orders trigger the right email/SMS confirmations and appear in an easy-to-manage dashboard for staff. • Integrate the new flow with Stripe or a similar gateway, keeping security and PCI compliance in mind. • Launch and manage Google Ads campaigns targeting local laundry keywords, write compelling ad copy, set up conversion tracking, and optimise regularly to improve ROI.
Preference will be given to freelancers who have prior experience working with wash-and-fold delivery laundromats.
If you can also bolt on a simple customer-feedback add-on later, that flexibility will be a bonus. The work is finished when customers can place a wash-and-fold order in minutes, the order shows up flawlessly in our system, and the ad dashboard proves those clicks are turning into sales.

item.title: Design & Implement Secure Online Members Area -- 2
item.description:

When in the members area, there would be a section that only the member and the admin can see : their registration documents, their groups database and information, training progress etc. There would also be a second area which would be a “communal area” for the members with access to all members. Establish or optimize appropriate social media business profiles.

item.title: Quick Project for WordPress & Elementor Website Creation
item.description:
30-250 USD | Budget: $50 USD Deadline: October 27, 2026 Time Zone: Eastern Time (EST/EDT) – Required daily updates during EST time (except Sundays)
I am looking for a freelancer experienced in WordPress and Elementor to build a four-page + contact page’s website, following the content, structure, layout direction, and design guidelines provided by us for each page. These are not existing pages to be edited or redesigned.
The final result must be a professional, fully functional, responsive website with a premium, modern, editorial-style design and a fully configured automatic translation system.
1. Website Development • Build the website directly in WordPress using Elementor in our hosting. • Create the website structure and navigation. • Design and build the pages using the provided content and guidelines. • Maintain a consistent visual identity across all pages. • Follow the specified typography, colors, spacing, imagery, layout, and visual hierarchy. • Create a professional menu according to the requirements, pages, contact page and footer. • Optimize the website for a premium, modern, editorial look. • Ensure responsive layouts for desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile. • Deliver functional pages, not mockups or screenshots.
The supplied documents must be treated as the creative and structural blueprint for the website. They explain what content belongs on each page and how it should be presented.
2. WordPress Administrator Access Required. The site must have my own WordPress Administrator login with full administrative permissions. Tasks: • Create or configure my individual Administrator account. • Confirm that I can log in independently and access the WordPress dashboard. • Ensure I can update page content, text, images, headings, links, and other website elements whenever necessary. • Ensure I can edit the website through Elementor without depending on the freelancer for routine updates. • Keep the website and its content on my hosting account. • Provide the necessary login and access instructions before final delivery.
This requirement is mandatory. The project will not be considered complete if I cannot independently access and manage my own website.
3. Automatic Translation Plugin Full Configuration Required.
The website must include a properly configured WordPress translation plugin that supports Spanish and Portuguese, with the ability to add more languages in the future.
The selected plugin must be configured according to the instructions provided, including the following setting:
“Translate Everything Automatically.”
The requirement is not simply to install or activate the plugin. The freelancer must complete the configuration and test the actual translation workflow.
Required functionality • Configure automatic translation for the entire website. • Support English, Spanish, and Portuguese. • Allow additional languages to be added in the future, subject to the selected plugin's capabilities and licensing. • Display a language selector that visitors can easily find and use. • Automatically display the selected language version of the complete page, including available page content and relevant website elements. • Ensure that visitors do not need to translate individual pages manually. • Ensure newly created or updated content can be processed through the automatic translation workflow according to the plugin's configuration. • Allow me to make occasional manual corrections to translations when necessary. • Test the language selector and translated pages on desktop and mobile.
The visitor must be able to select a preferred language and view the corresponding translated page without requiring the freelancer to translate every page manually.
Use the translation plugin selected or approved previously discuss for this project. If it has not yet been finalized, confirm the plugin and its compatibility before proceeding.
Any paid subscription, translation credits, or additional license costs must be disclosed and approved before purchase, and we will set own account. Do not substitute another plugin or change the required configuration without my approval.
Acceptance requirement: Demonstrate that the automatic translation setting is enabled and that the complete translation workflow works for the available languages. Installing the plugin alone does not satisfy this requirement.
4. Responsive Design & Quality Assurance Test all the pages on: • Desktop and laptop. • Tablet. • Mobile. Verify: • Navigation and links. • Language selector and translated page display. • Layout, typography, spacing, and image presentation. • Contact page and available contact functionality. • Footer and responsive behavior. • Elementor editing and WordPress Administrator access.
Correct any issues identified during testing that fall within the agreed scope.
5. Work Process & Communication • Work directly within my WordPress hosting environment and Elementor. • Work according to Eastern Time. • Provide progress updates during the project. • Communicate access requirements, blockers, or proposed changes promptly. • Obtain approval before changing the supplied content direction, design requirements, or selected translation plugin. • Do not consider the project complete until the website and translation system have been tested.
6. Final Deliverables. Before requesting final approval, the freelancer must provide: 1. Four completed and functional WordPress/Elementor pages. 2. Professional navigation, contact page, and footer. 3. Responsive layouts tested on desktop, tablet, and mobile. 4. My own working WordPress Administrator account. 5. A fully configured automatic translation plugin. 6. Spanish and Portuguese translation functionality, with future language additions supported by the selected plugin. 7. The required “Translate Everything Automatically” configuration enabled. 8. Successful tests of the language selector and translated pages. 9. Confirmation that I can independently edit pages, images, and content. 10. A brief handover explaining how to log in, edit pages, and manage the translation system. 7. Completion, Review, Acceptance & Payment Terms
Page-by-Page Review: Each page will be reviewed individually once the freelancer has completed and submitted it for review. • The freelancer must notify me when each page is ready for review. • I will review the completed page and provide feedback or request corrections where necessary. • The freelancer must address the agreed corrections before the page is considered approved. • Approval of an individual page does not constitute final project acceptance or authorize a partial payment. • All the pages must be completed, reviewed, corrected where necessary, and approved before the project can be considered finished.
Final Acceptance Requirements: The project will be considered complete only when: • All the pages are functional and approved. • Responsive checks have been performed on desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile. • An individual WordPress Administrator login is working and provides the required access, which has to located in a strategic location of the website. • The automatic translation plugin is fully configured, tested and properly funtional. • The “Translate Everything Automatically” setting is enabled as required. • Spanish and Portuguese translation functionality has been tested, and future language additions are supported by the selected plugin. • All agreed corrections have been completed, and all required deliverables have been provided.
A design mockup, an installed but unconfigured plugin, or a website that still requires manual translation of each page will not meet the project requirements.
The total project budget is $50 USD. No partial payments or milestone payments will be made. The full $50 USD payment will be released only after all the pages have been completed, individually reviewed, corrected where necessary, and approved, and all other agreed project requirements have been fulfilled.
Submitting or obtaining approval for an individual page does not entitle the freelancer to partial payment.
The project must be fully completed and approved before final payment is authorized, subject to the applicable platform rules and payment terms.

item.title: UK SEO Recovery Consultant
item.description:
18-36 GBP/hr | My site was hit hard after the 20 August Google update. There was no manual penalty, but the loss in organic visibility is significant and, despite multiple fixes, rankings have not bounced back. I’m now bringing in a fresh pair of expert eyes from inside the UK to work side-by-side with my in-house SEO.

Current toolkit Google Analytics and SEMrush are connected; you’re welcome to suggest or plug in anything else you rely on, as long as access is straightforward.
Deliverables 1. Written audit report outlining issues, impact, and priority. 2. Detailed action plan categorised by quick wins, mid-term tasks, and longer-term projects. 3. Live walkthrough call with my SEO so we’re clear on implementation. 4. Two follow-up check-ins (spread over the next eight weeks) to gauge progress and tweak strategy.
Acceptance criteria • Audit highlights root causes linked to the August update rather than generic advice. • Recommendations are actionable within our current tech stack (WordPress + custom PHP). • Early wins demonstrably lift key pages back toward their previous average positions.
If you have a track record of recovering sites after core updates, let’s talk and map out the road back to our pre-update performance.

item.title: Stripe Account Recovery and Compliance Fix
item.description: 250-750 USD | I am looking for a senior Stripe Compliance and Account Recovery Specialist to fix a critical issue with my US Stripe account under a US LLC. The account has been placed on "Pause" (Payouts and charges are restricted) due to a practical operational mistake on my end regarding how payments from Virtual Credit Cards (VCC) were processed. Review the exact reason for the pause within the Stripe dashboard. Analyze the data mismatch, web integration, or risk alerts that caused the freeze. Business Model: My business is registered in the US with a valid EIN and ITIN (I am a non-US resident, using my valid passport for verification). We manage and collect payments from booking platforms like Expedia, Booking.com, and Trip.com. The Mistake: Stripe requires that the Statement Descriptor (the name the client/bank sees) exactly matches each specific hotel published. Due to a lack of technical knowledge, I made the mistake of processing several payments from different hotels under a single main account. 1. The Trigger: After realizing this was an error, I tried to rapidly create multiple sub-accounts within a single group to split the hotels. This sudden change and payment consolidation triggered Stripe's risk algorithms, resulting in an immediate pause on payouts and processing. Note: All legal documentation (EIN, ITIN, Passport, LLC registration) is 100% clean and legitimate. The issue is purely an operational/risk policy trigger. Reconfigure the account structure from scratch if needed within 7 days. You will advise on how to handle multiple hotel payouts legally under Stripe’s architecture (e.g., proper use of Statement Descriptors or Stripe Connect if required), ensuring refund policies and payment flows meet 100% of Stripe’s guidelines.

item.title: Ecosend Email Setup & Automation
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I’m running a women’s wellness brand that offers a podcast, retreats and a paid membership, and I’m finally ready to get my email house in order inside Ecosend. My current broadcasts work, but the technical foundations and list structure are still missing.
Here’s what I need:
• Sender infrastructure: create a dedicated inbox for the sending address, connect my domain and fully authenticate it in Ecosend (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) so every reply lands in that new inbox. • Contact organisation: build a clear tagging framework driven mainly by Member status, but flexible enough to capture source and interests later. Apply the tags to my existing list. • Segmentation & automation: set up segments that use those tags, add a signup form, and wire a short welcome sequence (I’ll supply the copy). • Handover: supply either a concise written guide or a quick screen-recording that walks me through how to maintain tags, segments and future automations on my own.
My priority is to promote products and services to the right subscribers while staying fully UK-GDPR compliant, and I’m happy to sign an NDA. When you reply, please outline:
– Ecosend (and any other) platforms you’ve configured – One real-world example of a tagging or segmentation model you built – Your fixed-price quote for this project
Looking forward to getting this foundation sorted so my emails can finally perform the way they should.

item.title: Wix End-Lease Cleaning Site

item.title: Resolve WordPress PHP Version Error
item.description:
30-250 AUD | My WordPress site throws the message:
“Composer detected issues in your platform: Your Composer dependencies require a PHP version >= 8.3.0”.
At the moment I don’t even know which PHP version the server is running, and I’m not sure whether any particular plugin or theme is behind the problem. What I need is a clean, end-to-end fix that gets both the public site and the WordPress admin area working normally again.
Here’s how I see the job:
• Pinpoint the current server PHP version and, if it’s below 8.3, upgrade or adjust the hosting settings so that Composer stops complaining. • Audit core WordPress files, active plugins, and the theme for compatibility with PHP 8.3+. • Resolve any conflicts you uncover—this could involve editing or replacing outdated code, updating Composer dependencies, or recommending alternative plugins/themes. • Test thoroughly to confirm the front end and wp-admin load without errors. • Deliver a brief, plain-English summary of the steps you took and any ongoing maintenance I should keep in mind.
Please let me know: 1. A ballpark cost for the work. 2. How soon you can start and the estimated turnaround once you’re in the dashboard.
You’ll receive full WordPress admin and hosting (cPanel) access as soon as we agree on terms.

item.title: Build a Minimalist, Professional Dog-Training Website

item.title: API Integration for Travel Marketplace
item.description:
12-18 EUR/hr | I run a travel marketplace (frankenbridge.com) with a working Cloudflare Worker that proxies the Bókun API into a React tour-browser app on WordPress. I want to add many more external tour and activity suppliers, but I don’t know which booking system each one uses. Some may be OCTO/Ventrata, Rezdy, FareHarbor, TourCMS or Checkfront, and others may have a custom API, an XML feed or none at all. I need an expert who has integrated many of these systems. First, identify what each supplier uses and the best way to connect it, and tell me honestly when an integration isn’t worth building. Then build the integrations so tours, availability and prices appear in one unified grid and bookings reach the right supplier. Keep supplier keys server-side and document everything. You work on staging with sandbox credentials only; I never share production keys. I’m starting with a paid audit of my first few suppliers, then we agree the build step by step. Please propose your own audit fee and hourly rate.
Moreover, we are a small travel company near Frankfurt, Germany. Our website, frankenbridge.com, sells small-group local tours to travelers from the US, Canada and Latin America. It runs on WordPress, Elementor and TranslatePress (5 languages). Bookings run through Bókun, a third-party booking widget.
THE PROBLEM Google shows too few of our pages. Search Console, Oct 7, 2026: - 1,680 pages indexed, 914 not indexed - About 485 are the real problem: 278 "discovered, not indexed", 117 "duplicate, different canonical", 90 "crawled, not indexed" - Known pages grew from about 500 to 2,600 after we added language versions - 509 clicks in 3 months, almost all from people who already search our brand name We want travelers to find us by searching for tours, not for our name.
Second problem: purchase events from the Bókun checkout (an iframe) do not reach GA4, so we cannot measure bookings.
WHAT WE WANT Phase 1 (this project): a paid audit. No changes to the live site. You deliver a written report with a ranked fix list and a time estimate for each fix. Phase 2 (later, same person if the audit is good): fix indexing, hreflang, canonicals, titles and descriptions, and GSC / GA4 / GTM tracking. Phase 3: keywords, Google Business Profile, content and social media.
YOU MUST HAVE - Technical SEO on WordPress (indexing, canonicals, hreflang, sitemaps) - Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager - Experience with multilingual sites (TranslatePress or similar) - Clear written English
HOW WE WORK - Freelancer.com milestones only. No payments, chats or call links (Teams, Zoom) outside the platform. - Google tools by email invitation. We never share passwords. - WordPress at Editor level. Administrator only for one task, with an end date, after a backup. - Backup first. Written reports.
HOW TO APPLY We read every bid. Bids that skip these steps are ignored. Start your bid with the word FRANKFURT. Then answer: 1. List the top 3 causes of "crawled, not indexed" and how you would check each one. 2. How would you get purchase events from a third-party booking iframe into GA4? 3. Link one site whose search traffic you grew, and tell us what you did. 4. Give your fixed price for the Phase 1 audit and how many days it takes.

item.title: Shopify Website Development for Muse Club London
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | Hi! I’m looking for a freelancer to design and build a complete Shopify website for my new brand, Muse Club London.
I will send you a reference website. I really like its overall aesthetic, layout and shopping experience, and I would like you to use it as inspiration for my website while creating an original identity for Muse Club London.
The brand should feel feminine, trendy, premium and modern, with a clean luxury aesthetic. Our main target market is the UK, and most of our traffic will come from TikTok and Instagram.
For the launch, we will mainly be selling vanity and beauty cases in 4 different colours, but I will be adding more fashion and lifestyle accessories later.
I need a complete Shopify store including the homepage, product pages, collections, cart, checkout, About Us, Contact, FAQ, Shipping & Returns, Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions.
I would also like customer reviews, newsletter sign-up, discount codes, social media integration, payment and shipping setup, Meta/Facebook and Instagram integration, Meta Pixel, basic SEO and a fast checkout experience.
The mobile design is extremely important because most of our customers will visit the website through TikTok and Instagram. I want the website to look very premium and professional on mobile.
I will provide the logo, product pictures, product information, prices and the reference website.
I also want the Shopify store to be easy for me to manage afterwards so I can add new products, change pictures and prices, create discount codes and update the website myself.
Please let me know your price, how long it would take, what is included in your service and what you need from me to get started.
Thank you!
Muse Club London

item.title: Elevated X CMS Expert Needed
item.description:
50+ USD/hr | Elevated X / ELX Core & Nexus Developer — Ongoing Freelance Work
We operate an established subscription-based adult entertainment website using the Elevated X CMS platform.
Elevated X is currently upgrading/migrating our site to its newer Core/Nexus platform. Elevated X will handle the platform conversion and core functionality. We are looking for an experienced developer/webmaster who can become our ongoing, as-needed technical resource after the conversion.
IMPORTANT: Please do not apply unless you have actual experience working with Elevated X.
We are specifically looking for someone who is comfortable working within the native Elevated X/Core framework. We are NOT looking to replace Elevated X templates with a completely custom template or build a separate custom CMS.
Typical work may include:
* CSS and front-end styling * Improving the appearance and usability of existing Elevated X pages/templates * Layout and responsive/mobile adjustments * Implementing graphics and promotional elements * Creating or modifying landing pages * Assisting with Nexus affiliate/marketing implementation when appropriate * Minor PHP/HTML/CSS/JavaScript work * Troubleshooting issues as they arise * Working with Elevated X support when an issue needs to be addressed on their side * Maintaining compatibility with future Elevated X platform updates
This is not a full-time position and not a large development project.
We want to establish a relationship with a reliable developer who learns our site and can help us periodically when we need changes, improvements or troubleshooting.
The amount of work will vary. Some months may involve several projects; other months may require very little.
REQUIRED WHEN APPLYING
Please answer the following:
1. Which websites have you personally worked on that use Elevated X? 2. What specifically did you do on those sites? 3. Have you worked with Elevated X Core and/or Nexus, or primarily the older Elevated X platform? 4. Are you comfortable working within Elevated X’s existing framework rather than replacing it with a fully custom template? 5. What is your hourly rate? 6. What is your general availability for occasional/as-needed work?
Experience with adult subscription/membership sites, NATS, CCBill or similar platforms is a plus.
Please do not send a generic web-development proposal. We are specifically interested in developers with real Elevated X experience.

item.title: Multipurpose AI Development with n8n Integration
item.description:
5-10 GBP/hr | # Developer Needed for Multipurpose AI Agent — OpenAI, Mistral, n8n
### Job Description
I am looking for an experienced AI developer to complete the setup and integration of a multipurpose AI agent using existing infrastructure.
**Existing Infrastructure**
* Hetzner VPS running Ubuntu. * Docker environment. * Self-hosted n8n automation platform. * Existing web interface. * GitHub account. * OpenAI API access.
### Project Requirements
**1. AI Models**
* Integrate OpenAI models through the API. * Integrate Mistral AI models. * Configure the system to use appropriate models for different tasks. * Allow additional models to be integrated in the future.
**2. AI Agent and Interface**
* Configure the multipurpose AI agent. * Connect the agent to n8n for workflow execution. * Enable the agent to use authorised tools and external APIs. * Integrate with the existing web interface.
**3. Business Integrations**
Initial integrations will include:
* Shopify e-commerce store. * Easyship shipping and fulfilment. * Supplier APIs and additional business tools as required.
**4. Technical Requirements**
* Work with the existing infrastructure rather than rebuilding it. * Configure secure API connections and credentials. * Ensure reliable workflow execution, error handling and logging. * Provide documentation and a complete handover.
### Developer Requirements
Experience required in:
* OpenAI API and Mistral AI. * n8n and AI agent development. * REST APIs, webhooks and integrations. * Docker, Ubuntu and self-hosted applications. * Shopify API integration.
### Application Questions
Please provide:
1. Examples of AI agents you have developed using n8n. 2. Your experience integrating OpenAI and Mistral models. 3. Your proposed implementation approach. 4. Estimated cost, delivery time and any additional running costs.
**Important:** The core infrastructure already exists. I am looking for a developer to configure, integrate and complete the system cost-effectively without introducing unnecessary platforms or rebuilding existing components.
The project will be completed in stages, beginning with an assessment of the current installation.

item.title: Industry Website with News Section -- 2
item.description:

The heart of the site is a regularly updated blog/news section that I can manage myself. Whether you prefer WordPress, a headless CMS, or another modern stack, I’m open—as long as updating content is straightforward and the finished product loads quickly on all devices.

item.title: WordPress SEO Plugin Rescue
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My WordPress site on SiteGround ran smoothly until the SEO-optimization plugin began triggering slow load times and occasional crashes. I need an experienced WordPress technician to investigate the root cause, then advise whether repairing the current plugin or swapping it for a more stable alternative makes the most sense.
What I expect: • A quick diagnostic session to pinpoint why the SEO plugin is misbehaving and how it is impacting performance. • Clear guidance on repair vs replace, with pros, cons, and any licence or data-migration considerations. • Implementation of the chosen fix, followed by testing to confirm page-speed and stability are back to normal. • A concise summary of the steps you took so I can reference it later.
Looking ahead, I’d like this to be the start of an ongoing relationship—someone I can message whenever WordPress core, theme, or plugin updates create new headaches. If you’re comfortable with routine maintenance on SiteGround-hosted WordPress sites, let’s talk.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
